summary: PR-1326 adds a debug level to the payments AppLog. It goes through the same masking path as the existing levels, and all process records (ticket, independent code review, security review, CI on the head commit) are in order. However, logs.py is in the scope of LOG-1, which requires exhaustive evidence. The only registered LOG-1 control test is a sample test over an open domain, and no ledger evidence covers LOG-1, so the obligation can't be established with adequate evidence. Nothing is shown to be violated, so the decision is HOLD rather than REJECT, pending exhaustive LOG-1 evidence.
